C1287.title: Helibao Payment Fined 74.88 Million Yuan for Four Regulatory Violations
C1287.summary: On December 31, 2025, the Guangdong Branch of the People's Bank of China disclosed an administrative penalty against Guangzhou Helibao Payment Technology Co., Ltd. The company was warned and publicly criticized for four groups of violations involving clearing, payment acceptance terminals and related business, merchant management, and account management. Regulators confiscated 12.0802 million yuan in illegal gains and imposed a 62.7997 million yuan fine, totaling 74.8799 million yuan. One responsible individual was separately fined 925,000 yuan.
